title: Raise a loaded two-leg instrument stand by two holes
instruction: Raise both legs of the instrument stand by two 25 mm holes, from hole 1 to hole 3. Seat both pull pins, make the plate level within 3 mm, and release all robot contact for 1 second. Keep instrument acceleration below 3 g after a 5 ms filter and downward leg speed at most 0.2 m/s. Keep wrists below 60 N; over 80 N for 0.1 s aborts.
context: Reindex a delicate loaded instrument while supporting the plate and controlling unequal gas-assisted and pawl-equipped telescoping legs.
setup: One fixed physical source-42 case. Generated aluminium instrument stand: fixed inner legs 300 mm apart, 25 mm hole pitch, 38 mm sliding outer legs 250 g each, steel 8 mm pins with red 22x24 mm polymer knobs (50 g pin assemblies), 1 kg 160x380x20 mm plate with two capsule handles, bolted 2.2 kg instrument. Right leg gas assist29.05 N and left leg lift-cleared safety pawl. Green wooden120x120x50 mm block at(0.07,-0.15,0.7725)m. Complete63-shape dimensions/materials/inertias/neutral poses and joints in fixture.json; reset transforms in kit.initial(). Task rigid transform Rz(-90deg)+(0.55,0.15,-0.0525)m from native layout. YAM bases at(0.32,+/-0.305,1.15)m on220x240x400 mm bolted pedestal approximations, centres(0.32,+/-0.305,0.9475)m. SDK station table top0.7475 m. Added supports preserve all task-object relative geometry; arm/fixture path clearance remains unverified.
